coaching_and_governance_events.label: CBB coaching hires and programme governance decisions
coaching_and_governance_events.target: Identity of the next permanent head coach named by a programme (multi-outcome, No-all if none by deadline)
coaching_and_governance_events.why_distinct: Outcome is an administrative hiring decision by a university, driven by candidate pools, buyouts and reporting, not by any game or season performance that existing archetypes simulate.

overtime_periods.label: CBB overtime periods played
overtime_periods.target: Number of overtime periods played in a game (at least N OT periods)
overtime_periods.why_distinct: Requires a tie at end of regulation and of each OT period; depends on the distribution of the final margin at exactly zero, not on combined points, so game_total does not generate it.
